---
name: "nf-core/bedgraph_bedclip_bedgraphtobigwig"
description: "Convert bedgraph to bigwig with clip"
keywords:
- "bedgraph"
- "bigwig"
- "clip"
- "conversion"
components:
- "ucsc/bedclip"
- "ucsc/bedgraphtobigwig"
input:
- bedgraph:
    type: "file"
    description: "bedGraph file which should be converted.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(bedgraph) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bedGraph"
- sizes:
    type: "file"
    description: "File with chromosome sizes.\n\nStructure: [ path(sizes) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.sizes"
output:
- bigwig:
    type: "file"
    description: "bigWig coverage file relative to genes on the input file.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(bigwig) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bigWig"
- bedgraph:
    type: "file"
    description: "bedGraph file after clipping.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bedgraph)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bedGraph"
authors:
- "@drpatelh"
- "@KamilMaliszArdigen"
maintainers:
- "@drpatelh"
- "@KamilMaliszArdigen"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/ucsc/bedclip@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/ucsc/bedgraphtobigwig@0.0.0-6d1763b"
